deviations.description: The intake-audit memory/artifact APIs were unavailable in this Codex App surface; repository, GitHub CI, and frozen external release evidence were used.

The first source-freeze candidate was superseded after final-package rehearsal showed that added cross-manifest diagnostics had become the primary wrong-CQC/wrong-C1 status. Error priority was corrected to preserve COMPATIBILITY_BLOCKED and RELEASE_IDENTITY_BLOCKED, then every required validation was rerun before final source freeze.

The first rehearsal harness attempt stopped while refreshing an intentionally modified manifest because Windows PowerShell's .NET runtime lacked Path.GetRelativePath. A new isolated rehearsal root used a compatible descendant-path calculation and the entire rehearsal was rerun.
Frozen CQC regression ran from a disposable copy so historical tests could not write into the frozen checkout.
A fixed build timestamp was retained so the two final RC archives were byte-identical.
The repository RA1 record cannot contain the SHA of its own commit. Exact bundle SHA and bundle-SHA CI are recorded out of band in the external RC_RELEASE_RECORD.json after push.
GitHub Actions emitted an upstream Node.js 20 deprecation annotation for actions/checkout@v4 and actions/setup-python@v5; both workflows completed successfully.
